coverage.assessment: Exactly one positional path; no stdin; validation includes invalid arity. Standard help and -- are interface mechanics, not added product modes.
Strict UTF-8 and binary output avoid locale dependence; no Unicode normalization. Contract preserves decomposed e plus combining accent and non-ASCII edge spaces.
Only ASCII space/tab trim; rejects broad strip and splitlines alternatives for concrete semantic reasons.
Literal LF splitting retains trailing empty segments; a with two trailing LFs remains identical, interior double space remains intact.
CRLF replacement precedes bare CR; a CR b yields a LF b LF as approved.
Original input emptiness explicitly controls termination: empty stays empty; space-tab with no newline yields exactly one LF; existing trailing LFs are preserved.
Stdout only, no file modification or output destination mode; exact output plus unchanged input digest required for CLI acceptance checks.

Complete read/decode before emission prevents a valid prefix escaping before late invalid UTF-8. Missing paths, directories and undecodable input each require status 2, diagnostic stderr and empty stdout.

No product size threshold; proportional-memory buffering limitation stated explicitly, simpler than streaming with second pass or temporary storage. Large finite validation plus guard inspection is appropriately bounded.

structural_review.plan: All technical-context fields filled; concrete proposed structure; before/after constitution gates; requirement/validation matrix; justified complexity tradeoff.
structural_review.research: Decisions, rationales and alternatives cover transformation, encoding, interfaces, validation; no unresolved product unknown or external integration requires investigation.
structural_review.data_model: Transient entities, fields, relationships, validation, state transitions and invariants; persistence/migrations explicitly inapplicable.
structural_review.contract: User-facing CLI is external, so required contract exists with invocation, channels, transformations and exact examples.
structural_review.quickstart: Prerequisites, future unittest command, binary subprocess assertion matrix and runnable smoke commands with expected exact bytes; clearly states implementation does not yet exist.

constitution_review: Standard library only; local deterministic pure transform plus thin CLI; explicit nine human choices retained; unit tests planned; no source implementation, integration or acceptance claimed.

fact_inference_boundary.facts: Current documents were read and SHA-256 computed directly; all nine requirements and exact acceptance examples appear consistently in design and validation.
fact_inference_boundary.inference: The specified algorithm satisfies those examples and is idempotent. This is design review, not evidence of implemented behavior or executed tests.

limitations: Prerequisite/hook execution is reported by the core checkpoint; this review does not independently replay authoring setup or hooks.
Implementation tests remain future work and were not run during planning review.
